Title: StorSimple Virtual Device Series transitioning to the new Azure portal

Body.Content:
Last November, we announced the availability of the StorSimple Virtual Device Series in the new Azure portal. 

 

Starting March 2, 2017, StorSimple Virtual Device Series managers will no longer be available in the Azure classic portal and will be available only in the new portal. If your existing StorSimple Virtual Devices Series managers haven't been transitioned from the classic portal to the new portal (as described in our email communication to you), they will be transitioned on this date. If you are on the US Government cloud, the transition date will be March 9, 2017. 

 

After the transition is complete:

  • All your StorSimple Virtual Device Series managers in the classic portal will be managed only through the new portal.
  • StorSimple Virtual Device Series management will no longer be available in the classic portal.
  • If you also own StorSimple physical devices, they will continue to be managed via the classic portal.

For more information on the transition and the new portal experience, refer to the detailed blog post Transitioning the StorSimple Virtual Device Series to the new Azure portal.
